offence_note: Break and enter a dwelling house and commit robbery (home invasion)
sentence_quote: Taking into account all of the circumstances in this relatively unusual case, I sentence you Mr. Drydgen for Count 1 to four years.
note: Resentencing on count 1 only; separate 6 months consecutive for driving offences remains on record.

offence_note: Several sexual offences against a complainant over many years
sentence_quote: Leave to appeal sentence is granted, but the appeal from sentence is dismissed.

offence_note: Sexual assault and sexual interference of stepdaughter over several years
sentence_quote: I would grant leave to appeal sentence, allow the appeal and reduce the sentence on count four to forty months imprisonment
note: Forty months is after credit for pre-sentence custody; conviction on son's count set aside.

sentence_quote: a sentence of one year in custody followed by three years' probation is not so high as to be unfit
note: Three months deducted by trial judge for age and health hardship.

offence_note: Failing to remain at scene of accident knowing it resulted in death
sentence_quote: The probation order is varied from 18 months to 12 months.
note: Custody term not stated; 20 months 21 days credited against 5-year driving prohibition.

offence_note: Sexual assault, choking, confinement, threats, assault, breach of probation
sentence_quote: Leave to appeal sentence is granted but the sentence appeal is dismissed.
note: 9 years plus two consecutive 6-month terms; unfortunate background acknowledged.

offence_note: Sexual offences against three children, child pornography, threats, breaches
sentence_quote: Accordingly, I would allow the appeal as to the custodial portion of the sentence imposed, set it aside and impose a global sentence of 10 years less pre-trial custody.
note: Footnote says sentence imposed was eight years one month after pre-sentence custody; youth offences got reprimands.

offence_note: Sexual assault, voyeurism, two breaches of probation
sentence_quote: The sentence appeal is allowed, but only to the extent of increasing the credit for pre-sentence custody from 24 months to 25.5 months.
note: Credit raised to 25.5 months under Summers; trial judge found no mitigating factors.

offence_note: Aggravated assault, assault of police officer, breach of probation
sentence_quote: Mr. Thibault will serve 14 months in custody for aggravated assault on Mr. Hall, a concurrent 6 months for assault on the officer, and a concurrent 30 days breaching the condition of his Probation Order.
note: Conditional sentence considered and rejected; other mitigating factors not fully shown.

offence_note: Failing to stop after accident causing bodily harm; driving while prohibited
sentence_quote: While leave to appeal the sentence is granted, the sentence appeal is also dismissed.
note: 44 months plus 10 months consecutive; judge considered few mitigating factors, unspecified.
